comment: A theme kept in custom properties and read by color functions (hsl(var(--x)), hsl(var(--x) / 0.6), rgba(var(--rgb), 0.25), rgb(var(--rgb)), color-mix() with a var() operand) in backgrounds, borders, box-shadow, outline and a gradient; switching the <html> element to the dark theme with a class at runtime (the selectors that may match the root are banded again for its new class) changes every color changes every color at runtime. Tolerance: a hardware GPU anti-aliases a few edge pixels of the light capture differently: 0.102 % bad pixels (55, scattered: clusters of at most 4 pixels) on an NVIDIA GTX 1080 (Vulkan, driver 580) against the default limit 0.100 %; the hardware limit is that plus about 20 % (the goldens' renderer keeps the default), the channel threshold and the cluster limit stay at the defaults.
